description: Compares the documents of one purchase line by line: purchase requisition, purchase order, order confirmation, goods receipt and invoice, in any combination of two or more. Returns the verdicts (requisition, order confirmation, 2-way match, 3-way match), the header fields that differ (order reference, supplier, currency, payment terms, Incoterms, cost centre, approval), per line the quantity, unit price and delivery date of every document with a status, and ready-made queries to the supplier and for internal clarification. Without a purchase order the next best document becomes the reference. Read the fields from the documents yourself and pass them as data; the tool does not read files. Numbers as JSON numbers, dates as YYYY-MM-DD. German keys work too (nummer, bestellbezug, datum, lieferant, waehrung, zahlungsziel, kostenstelle, freigabe, summe, positionen with pos, material, text, menge, einheit, preis, preiseinheit, betrag, liefertermin). With vendor_master the bank details of the invoice are checked as in check_invoice_payment. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

goods_receipt.description: Same fields as purchase_order. Goods receipt or delivery note: number, order_reference, date, lines with the quantity accepted.

invoice.description: Same fields as purchase_order. Invoice: number, order_reference, date, supplier, vat_id, iban, currency, payment_terms, total, lines with quantity, price and amount.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

order_confirmation.description: Same fields as purchase_order. Order confirmation from the supplier: number, order_reference, date, supplier, currency, payment_terms, incoterms, lines.

purchase_order.description: Purchase order: number, requisition_reference, date, supplier, currency, payment_terms, incoterms, cost_centre, lines.

by.description: Name or role of the approver.

status.description: Approval status, e.g. approved, pending, rejected.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR. Default EUR.

iban.description: Invoice only: IBAN the invoice asks to pay to.

incoterms.description: Incoterms as written, e.g. DAP Cologne.

price_unit.description: Quantity the price refers to, for example 100 for a price per 100 pieces. Default 1.

unit.description: Unit of measure, e.g. pcs, kg, h.

order_reference.description: Purchase order number this document refers to. Leave out on the purchase order itself.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms as written, e.g. 30 days net, 2 % within 10 days.

requisition_reference.description: On the purchase order: the requisition number it refers to.

supplier.description: Supplier name as on the document.

vat_id.description: Invoice only: VAT ID of the supplier.

purchase_requisition.description: Same fields as purchase_order. Purchase requisition (BANF): number, date, supplier wanted, cost_centre, approval, lines with estimated price and wanted delivery date.

tolerances.description: Tolerances. Defaults: price 0.5 %, quantity 0 %, delivery date 2 days, order price above the requisition estimate 10 %.

budget_percent.description: Allowed variance against budget in percent.

vendor_master.description: Optional vendor master rows for the payment check of the invoice: no (vendor number), name, vat_id, iban, country, last_payment (YYYY-MM-DD or null), blocked (bool).

name: match_documents
title: Match purchase requisition, purchase order, order confirmation, goods receipt and invoice: 2-way and 3-way match with ready-made queries
